gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-nunito: Nunito reads soft and round, its terminals stopping well short of the stem. Jelly Crazies wobbles above it with bowls nearly sealed shut, and a longer stretch of text slows to a leisurely walk before it.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-pilcrow-roun: Playful wobble runs through Jelly Crazies, whose bowls nearly seal shut and never thin like a pen. Pilcrow Rounded keeps curves that refuse to close, so a long page of it feels warm and unhurried.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-quicksand: Playful and wobbly, Jelly Crazies keeps its bowls nearly shut. It is built for a slow, lingering line, while Quicksand has tall, bulb-like bowls and open terminals that carry ordinary text with ease.
gen-dafont-joystix-fs-quicksand: Bold arcade lettering in Joystix spreads wide, its stems only slightly heavier than the arms that join them. Quicksand is the opposite: soft, glassy bowls with horizontals as thick as verticals.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-fs-nunito: Wide, loose tracking gives Lemon Milk its look, with tubular strokes like bent copper pipe. And Nunito brings round, approachable lowercase underneath, so the pair's friendliest quality is how inviting both feel.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-fs-quicksand: Friendly rounded letters in Lemon Milk trace a single-width line like a rolling-ball pen, spaced loose and wide. Quicksand follows with tall glassy bowls that keep a longer read light.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-fs-hind: A lingering rhythm, one character per beat, defines Minecraftia and its towering lowercase. Hind answers with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, so Minecraftia is the one to linger over and Hind the one to move quickly through.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-fs-nunito: Nunito reads round and approachable, with terminals finishing clear of the stem. And if Minecraftia were shrunk down, its steep letter contrast would crowd, while Nunito stays easy at any size.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-fs-pilcrow-rounde: Pilcrow Rounded reads as a flat gray hum of constant line weight, warm and tall in the lowercase. But Minecraftia pushes fat ribbon stems against thread-thin hairlines, and that clash is the strongest thing about the pair.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-hind: Hind sets a plain sans body whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, with strokes steady as a drawn string. But Nasalization is the friendlier voice, floating its letters apart, while Hind does the quiet, dependable work of carrying text.
